4 اوضخ بِالدَّلْوِ He drew water with the bucket and shook it about vehemently [app. so that it did not become, or remain full]: or he drew with it little water. (L.) [See also 1.] ―
-b2- اوضخ لَهُ He drew for him little, or a little, water. (S, L, K.) ―
-b3- Also, اوضخت البِئْرُ The well contained little water; its water became little; (K;) water having been taken from it for irrigation. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
